title: ClarificationBrief
description: Output contract for the Product Clarification Agent. Every field is required. Schema validation is enforced by the Team Orchestrator before any artifact is saved.

intake_assessment_artifact_id.description: Optional audit link to the intake_assessment artifact that produced this brief.

restated_goal.description: 1-2 sentences. What the agent understood the user to be asking for. Must not add scope that was not implied.

problem_statement.description: The underlying user problem, stated independently of any solution. Must not say 'build X' or 'add Y'. Must say 'users currently cannot Z' or equivalent.

target_user.description: Who this affects. Must reference user definitions from PRODUCT.md.

in_scope.description: What is explicitly included. Must have at least one item.

out_of_scope.description: What is explicitly excluded. Must have at least one item. A Brief with no out-of-scope is incomplete.

items.description: Each criterion must describe something observable or measurable. No 'works well', 'feels good', 'users are happy'.
Each question must be non-obvious (not answerable from the original input), must unlock a scope or acceptance-criteria decision, and must be specific enough for the human to answer concisely.

open_questions.description: The blocking gaps the human must answer (the clarify branch). EMPTY on a proceed_direct brief, where the intake already satisfied the contract. More than 5 indicates the intake was too underspecified — set context_integrity.rating to red.

domain_terms.description: Domain-specific terms referenced in this Brief. Definitions must match DOMAIN.md. May be empty if no domain terms are referenced.

staleness_flags.description: Names of canonical documents that appear stale or missing. Empty array if all docs are current and present.

rating.description: green = all docs present and current, no flags. yellow = docs present but flagged or goal references undefined terms. red = one or more required docs absent.

reasoning.description: Why this rating was assigned. What would need to change to reach green.

handoff.description: Downstream handoff to CCA/BA. Present on a FINAL brief (proceed_direct or post-Pass-B); absent on a draft.

feature_intent.description: The finalized restated_goal, passed as CCA/BA --feature-intent.

concepts_to_check.description: Salient entity nouns seeding CCA's existence sweep. Additive; never narrows CCA's full sweep.

design_inputs.description: Carried-forward references to rich intake (e.g. Figma/screenshots) for the UX Design stage. Phase 2 populated. PCA references, never re-models, these.
